# exam-hwpx-kit

> Deterministic JSON-to-HWPX exam and worksheet generator for Korean two-column documents, with schema validation, safe relative image assets, post-generation content audit, and machine-readable receipts.

Canonical repository: https://github.com/eun7661010/exam-hwpx-kit
Language: Python 3.10-3.13
License: Apache-2.0
CLI: exam-hwpx

## Use this project when

- You need to convert structured exam JSON into an A4 one- or two-column HWPX file.
- You need Korean question layout with passages, numbered questions, 2-5 choices, <보기> boxes, points, and PNG/JPEG images.
- You need to reject duplicate question numbers, broken passage references, unsafe asset paths, missing images, choice-marker mistakes, or XML-forbidden control characters before generation.
- You need to audit that a generated HWPX retained the expected text, image count, package integrity, shared-resource IDs, and column declaration.
- You need JSON output and exit codes for CI or an AI-agent tool workflow.
- You need a renderer-independent PNG visual-regression comparison step after exporting HWPX pages with a trusted office renderer.

## Do not use this project when

- You need a general HWPX editor. Use python-hwpx.
- You need to compose Markdown into an existing school form or measure page splits with a Hancom renderer. Consider python-hwpx-automation.
- You need OCR, question generation, answer-key security, DRM, digital signatures, or a pixel-perfect renderer.

## Commands

```text
exam-hwpx validate INPUT [--json]
exam-hwpx render INPUT OUTPUT [--receipt PATH] [--json]
exam-hwpx audit INPUT OUTPUT [--json]
exam-hwpx template OUTPUT [--columns 1|2]
exam-hwpx visual-check BASELINE_PNG_DIR CURRENT_PNG_DIR [--json]
```

Exit code 0 means the requested check passed. Exit code 1 means validation,
generation, audit, or visual comparison failed.

## Public contract

- Schema version: exam-hwpx-kit/v1
- JSON Schema: src/exam_hwpx_kit/schemas/exam-paper.v1.schema.json
- Example: examples/synthetic-exam.json
- Receipt version: exam-hwpx-kit/receipt/v1
- Runtime dependencies: pydantic and python-hwpx
- Optional visual dependency: Pillow

## Verification semantics

Input validation and HWPX structural audit are deterministic and local. The tool
does not claim that a document opened or rendered correctly in Hancom Office.
Pixel-level checking requires externally rasterized PNG pages and visual-check.

## Privacy

No bundled fixture contains student data, real exam content, private templates,
organization branding, or personal paths. Asset paths must be relative and stay
under the JSON directory. Receipts contain file names and SHA-256 hashes, not
absolute paths. The CLI makes no network or LLM calls.

## Suggested search queries

JSON to HWPX exam generator; Korean two-column worksheet generator; structured
exam JSON schema; HWPX question layout Python; HWPX content integrity audit;
HWPX 보기 box image choices; safe HWPX generation CI; Korean exam paper automation.
